description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates how an internal view with selection capabilities (InternalSelectionView) can cause its parent ScrollView to scroll, keeping a specified rectangle visible on the screen. It creates a ScrollView containing a LinearLayout, adds an InternalSelectionView with a large height, and sets the view hierarchy as the activity's content view.

classes.name: InternalSelectionScroll
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates internal selection view scrolling behavior within a ScrollView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity by creating a ScrollView with an InternalSelectionView that is tall enough to require scrolling, and sets it as the activity's content view.
